item.title: Vacaville High girls soccer sweeps MEL awards
item.description: Junior striker Sophia Franzoni took home the league’s MVP award, while junior midfielder Samantha Mac Niven was named Offensive Player of the Year. Fittingly, senior twin sisters, Emma and Kallie Stacey were named Co-Defensive Players of the Year.

item.title: Local Roundup: Vacaville’s Wight places eighth at state wrestling tournament
item.description: Wight finishes his high school career as a state medalist, three-time Monticello Empire League champion, three-time Sac-Joaquin Section Division champion and a four-time Section Masters medalist.
